steps.speaker: Anxious Mother
steps.content: No...! My child is still inside...
A disheveled woman falls to her knees in tears. Flora, ready to take action, takes her hand and promises her in a reassuring tone.

steps.speaker: Flora
steps.content: Don't worry, ma'am, I will save your child!

steps.speaker: Anxious Mother
steps.content: It's you... I saw you in the news about the firefighter's commendation! Please, save my daughter!!
The mother pleads as if she's found her savior. Flora, seeing you next to her, hands the helpless woman's hand into yours.

steps.speaker: Flora
steps.content: Take care of her for me, alright Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sure, and you must be careful.
Flora nods firmly and then turns to enter the "fire scene" simulated with lights and projections.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: The fire is so intense. The firefighter has been gone for so long. Could it be...

steps.speaker: Anxious Mother
steps.content: No, it can't be! Please, be safe...!
A heavy thud interrupts her prayers as the prop house collapses. The woman screams and nearly faints, and it was then she hears the cries of surprise from others.
In the midst of the flames, you see Flora, carrying a little girl, lifting huge "ruins" out of the way single-handedly like a savior with divine strength, rescuing those in need.
At last, Flora emerges from the fire and returns the girl to her mother carefully. The mother and daughter embrace each other and cry in relief, and the woman looks up and thanks Flora profusely.

steps.speaker: Anxious Mother
steps.content: I really can't thank you enough...!

steps.speaker: Flora
steps.content: It is my duty. Saving lives is what a firefighter should do! The scene is dangerous. Everyone, please, move to a safer place!
